# LOTTE Biologics

LOTTE Biologics is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. LOTTE BIOLOGICS is a company (CDMO) specialized in drug consignment development and production and aims for a healthy life for patients around the world. LOTTE Biologics employs 435 people (+27.6% YoY, +132 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, South Korea, United Kingdom, Japan, and Puerto Rico).

## About

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, LOTTE Biologics operates integrated biologics facilities in the United States and South Korea. Through a unified Dual Hub Service model, LOTTE Biologics enhances supply security, supports manufacturing scalability, and maintains consistent quality standards across regions.

LOTTE Biologics provides modular, phase-appropriate manufacturing solutions spanning preclinical through commercial stages, with proven capability in producing mammalian-cell-based biologics, including monoclonal antibodies, fusion proteins, and multispecific modalities. 

At the Syracuse Bio Campus in New York, LOTTE Biologics delivers high-quality GMP drug substance manufacturing supported by more than 62 global regulatory approvals. The site offers 40,000 L of total capacity across eight 5,000 L stainless steel bioreactors and includes analytical and warehouse infrastructure. In addition, the company has expanded into Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs) through strategic investment in onsite conjugation suites, enabling a streamlined, end-to-end pathway from biologic drug substance production to ADC manufacturing within a single campus.

In South Korea, LOTTE Biologics is constructing three advanced bio plants at the Songdo Bio Campus. With the first facility already underway and scheduled for operation in 2027, each plant will include eight 15,000 L stainless steel bioreactors for commercial production, supported by multiple 3,000 L bioreactors for clinical-scale needs. Collectively, these plants will provide a manufacturing volume exceeding 360,000L in bioreactor capacity.

Guided by the vision “Possibilities Beyond Limits,” LOTTE Biologics is committed to serving as a long-term, trusted partner, supporting efficient scale-up, dependable manufacturing execution, and the continuous advancement of clients’ therapeutic programs.

survivors.summary:
LOTTE Biologics is a growing CDMO focused on development and production of biologics. Key points:

- Scale and footprint
  - 435 employees (growth: +27.6% YoY)
  - Headquartered in Seoul, with presence in the United States; operations across 6 countries (US, South Korea, UK, Japan, Puerto Rico, Switzerland)
  - In Korea, building three advanced bio plants at Songdo Bio Campus; Plant 1 due to operate in 2027. Combined capacity exceeds 360,000 L bioreactor volume (eight 15,000 L stainless steel reactors plus supporting 3,000 L units for clinical-scale work)

- Hiring and teams
  - Active postings: 3 current openings (Associate Scientist, AS&T; Senior Manager Quality Shared Services; Senior Project Manager, PMO)
  - Workforce distribution: majority in the United States (329 of 435), with significant Korea presence; diverse departmental mix (Research, Technical, Operations, etc.)
  - Notable leadership and roles across Quality, Operations, IT, HR, Supply Chain, ADC Manufacturing, and Sales

- Strategic drivers and signals
  - Expanding manufacturing capacity and dual-site network (US and Korea) aligns with growth in biologics and CDMO services
  - Songdo Plant 1 completion signals near-term scale-up for commercial production and potential trial operations in H2 2026–2027
  - Public activity (BIO International Convention participation) indicates active marketing of capabilities to biopharma sponsors

- Hiring signal relative to your query
  - Rapid team scaling is evident via facility expansion and ongoing hiring, particularly in roles tied to quality, project management, and associate scientist tracks
  - Clinical staff shortage context could be touched by Songdo’s mix of commercial and clinical-scale bioreactor capacity, supporting both development and manufacturing needs

If you’re tracking healthcare/biotech growth through new facility openings and aggressive hiring, LOTTE Biologics demonstrates a strong push in 2025–2026 toward expanded biologics manufacturing capacity, augmented by multiple international sites and continued talent acquisition.

Guided by the vision “Possibilities Beyond Limits,” LOTTE Biologics is committed to serving as a long-term, trusted partner, supporting efficient scale-up, dependable manufacturing execution, and the continuous advancement of clients’ therapeutic programs.

# FUJIFILM Biotechnologies (FUJIFILM Diosynth Biotechnologies U.S.A., Inc.)

FUJIFILM Biotechnologies is a Biotechnology Research company. FUJIFILM Diosynth Biotechnologies is a CDMO partner for life. Their focus is to combine technical leadership in cell culture, microbial fermentation, and cell and gene therapy with world class cGMP manufacturing facilities to advance tomorrow’s medicines. FUJIFILM Biotechnologies employs 4,575 people (+13.7% YoY, +711 people) and has an annual revenue of $246M. Headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, United States, with presence in Denmark and United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across 37 countries (including United States, Denmark, United Kingdom, Ireland, and Romania). Has $850M in total funding.

## About

For over 30 years, FUJIFILM Biotechnologies' mission has been advancing tomorrow’s medicine. As a CDMO, we work in partnership with the most innovative biopharma and biotech companies across the world who are reimagining healthcare’s potential. We help to accelerate their progress, expand their capabilities, streamline their processes, and strengthen their innovation. So when our customers’ potential cures, vaccines, biologics, and accomplishments make strides – or even become new realities for patients – we know our work, our manufacturing expertise, and our partnership helped make it happen. 

We aren't simply a workplace. FUJIFILM Biotechnologies a community and place of passion – a place of what we call Genki. A place where diverse perspectives and people come to life. Where opportunity for growth has no end. Where passion is followed, discovered, and nurtured. Where the energy is undeniable, enthusiasm is pervasive, and drive is infectious. All of our global locations burst with curiosity, inspiration, and extraordinary purpose. 

So as we continue to grow our teams, our global locations, and our capabilities, Genki will always be our cultural tie. That’s why we’re always looking for passionate, mission-driven people who want to commit their life’s work to enabling better outcomes for patients and their families. 

For a full listing of jobs that will propel, inspire, and fulfill you, please visit: https://fujifilmbiotechnologies.fujifilm.com/careers/

We created this space on LinkedIn to give people a window into our work and culture. We’re highlighting employees’ passion, current openings, and why it’s never been a more exciting time to join!

FUJIFILM Biotechnologies (Fujifilm) is a rapidly growing biotech CDMO with a strong emphasis on cell culture, microbial fermentation, and cell/gene therapy, complemented by cGMP manufacturing facilities. Key points relevant to your query:

- Growth and hiring: Significant headcount expansion (employees ~4,575; YoY growth +13.7%; ongoing hiring across multiple roles). Public-facing posts highlight active recruitment across engineering, manufacturing, QA, upstream/downstream operations, digital/automation, and site support.
- Scaling footprint: Headquarters in Morrisville, NC, with operations in Denmark and the UK; large-scale manufacturing sites (notably Holly Springs, NC) expanding to support clinical and commercial supply. The Holly Springs campus is expanding capacity and hiring broadly to staff new shifts and roles.
- Manufacturing and technical focus: Strength in cell culture manufacturing, with co-located clinical and commercial capabilities, and a push toward advancing tomorrow’s medicines through engineered processes and GMP excellence.
- Regulatory and program milestones: The Holly Springs site has engaged with FDA programs (PreCheck Pilot) to accelerate readiness and reduce regulatory uncertainty, indicating ongoing regulatory expansion/diligence alongside scale-up.
- Signals for roles you care about (high/signal regarding your query): 
  - Large-scale hiring across multiple disciplines (engineering, operations, QA, maintenance, MES, supply chain). 
  - New facility openings and expansions (e.g., Holly Springs; other sites) with generated press coverage about job creations and economic impact.
  - Active internal recruitment messaging and announcements showing sustained headcount growth into 2025–2026.

If you’re focused on the healthcare/biotech/pharma recruitment landscape for 2025–2026, Fujifilm Biotechnologies exemplifies a company heavily scaling teams, opening/expanding facilities, and engaging with regulatory readiness programs—consistent with high-signal indicators for internal recruiters tracking rapid hiring, multi-role engineering and clinical/manufacturing staffing shortages, and facility-based growth.

# OmniaBio (OmniaBio Inc.)

OmniaBio is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. OmniaBio is a company that specializes in cell and gene therapy CDMO services. They are a highly efficient and specialized partner of choice for manufacturing therapeutics from preclinical to commercial scale. OmniaBio employs 147 people (+11.9% YoY, +19 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across Canada and United States.

## About

OmniaBio is redefining the future of cell therapy manufacturing through its proprietary AI-powered Intelligent Factory™. Purpose-built to accelerate discoveries and industrialize production, the Intelligent Factory™ integrates artificial intelligence and automation across the entire manufacturing lifecycle.

With a focus on autologous CAR-T and other advanced therapies, OmniaBio’s platform enables scalable, efficient, and high-fidelity production by embedding predictive analytics, robotic bioprocessing, and digital quality systems into a unified, closed-loop system. This approach not only enhances throughput and consistency but also positions OmniaBio as a next-generation CDMO partner for innovators seeking to bring life-saving therapies to patients faster.

OmniaBio is redefining the future of cell therapy manufacturing through its proprietary AI-powered Intelligent Factory™. Purpose-built to accelerate discoveries and industrialize production, the Intelligent Factory™ integrates artificial intelligence and automation across the entire manufacturing lifecycle.

With a focus on autologous CAR-T and other advanced therapies, OmniaBio’s platform enables scalable, efficient, and high-fidelity production by embedding predictive analytics, robotic bioprocessing, and digital quality systems into a unified, closed-loop system. This approach not only enhances throughput and consistency but also positions OmniaBio as a next-generation CDMO partner for innovators seeking to bring life-saving therapies to patients faster.

# Neovance (Neovance L.P.)

Neovance is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. Neovance is a solutions hub and financial assistance non-commercial specialty pharmacy field reimbursement (frm) nursing support services expertise company that helps patients improve outcomes through technology technology. They have over 35 years of experience and build solutions that identify where scripts get lost and recover them. Their goal is to drive better outcomes by enabling more patients to get on and stay on therapy. Neovance employs 292 people (+90.7% YoY, +206 people). # Apogee Therapeutics (Apogee Therapeutics, Inc.)

Apogee Therapeutics (APGE) is a Biotechnology Research company. Apogee Therapeutics is a clinical stage biotechnology company advancing differentiated biologics for the treatment of inflammatory and immune diseases. They believe in reshape the current standard of care for these diseases and aim to provide better treatment options. Apogee Therapeutics employs 251 people, founded in 2022. Headquartered in United States, with offices in Waltham and San Francisco. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Germany, Canada, Denmark, and Spain). Has a $2.2B market cap. IPO 2023.

## About

Apogee Therapeutics is a biotechnology company advancing novel, potentially best-in-class therapies to address the needs of the millions of people living with immunological and inflammatory disorders.

# CuraTeQ Biologics (CuraTeQ Biologics Pvt. Ltd.)

CuraTeQ Biologics is a Biotechnology Research company. CuraTeQ Biologics is an EU GMP certified biopharmaceutical company based out of Hyderabad, India. Their vision is to provide high quality biosimilars for patients across the globe. CuraTeQ Biologics employs 528 people (+28.3% YoY, +147 people), founded in 2016. Headquartered in Kuwait, with presence in United States and India. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including India, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Malta, and Iceland).

## About

𝗖𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗧𝗲𝗤 𝗕𝗶𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗰𝘀 (a wholly owned subsidiary of Aurobindo Pharma Ltd.) is an 𝗘𝗨 𝗚𝗠𝗣 𝗰𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗲𝗱 biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Hyderabad, India. Our vision is to improve the wellbeing of patients suffering from debilitating illnesses by providing them access to high quality and cost-effective biosimilars. 

CuraTeQ has a development pipeline of 14 biosimilars, of which, three products have been filed with EMA, one product has been filed with MHRA, and four more products are in global phase 3 clinical trials.

# Merck Healthcare (Merck Healthcare KGaA)

Merck Healthcare is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, a leading science and technology company, operates across Healthcare, Life Science and Electronics. Merck Healthcare employs 4,243 people (+11.7% YoY, +741 people), founded in 1668. Headquartered in Darmstadt, Hessen, Germany. Its workforce is distributed across 86 countries (including Germany, Switzerland, India, Brazil, and France).

## About

Life is a beautiful gift and health is what allows us to enjoy it. That is why we are deeply committed to helping patients. No matter how complex or rare the disease may be, we don‘t give up. Our ~17,800 Healthcare employees wake up every day motivated by our purpose: To help create, improve and prolong lives – as one for patients. 
We are the Healthcare business of Merck, and the only pharmaceutical company that is developing solutions along the whole “circle of life”. For over 350 years, patients have always been at the heart of everything we do. 
Our pioneering work in cancer treatment is focused on discovering, developing and delivering science-driven breakthrough therapies that turn cancer patients into cancer survivors. Our tireless passion for R&D as well as a creative and focused approach help accelerate innovation in oncology and immuno-oncology.

To realize our ambition, we’ve created a balanced portfolio. Our core business helps provide a strong foundation, fund innovation and mitigate risks. Our specialty portfolio enables us to be on the frontlines of change and truly become a specialty innovator. 
We have a proud history of advancing care in immunology for people living with chronic progressive diseases such as multiple sclerosis. For more than two decades we have maintained our commitment to delivering innovative solutions across treatment, devices, and support services. This dedication drives the research and development of our pipeline products and our efforts to address areas of unmet medical need. 

Today, we are a global market leader in the field of fertility treatments. Our therapeutic portfolio, devices and advanced fertility technologies have helped many couples achieve their dream of having a baby. Everyone should have the opportunity to become a parent. To date, more than 5 million babies have been brought into the world with the help of our leading fertility products.

Life is a beautiful gift and health is what allows us to enjoy it. That is why we are deeply committed to helping patients. No matter how complex or rare the disease may be, we don‘t give up. Our ~17,800 Healthcare employees wake up every day motivated by our purpose: To help create, improve and prolong lives – as one for patients. 
We are the Healthcare business of Merck, and the only pharmaceutical company that is developing solutions along the whole “circle of life”. For over 350 years, patients have always been at the heart of everything we do. 
Our pioneering work in cancer treatment is focused on discovering, developing and delivering science-driven breakthrough therapies that turn cancer patients into cancer survivors. Our tireless passion for R&D as well as a creative and focused approach help accelerate innovation in oncology and immuno-oncology.

To realize our ambition, we’ve created a balanced portfolio. Our core business helps provide a strong foundation, fund innovation and mitigate risks. Our specialty portfolio enables us to be on the frontlines of change and truly become a specialty innovator. 
We have a proud history of advancing care in immunology for people living with chronic progressive diseases such as multiple sclerosis. For more than two decades we have maintained our commitment to delivering innovative solutions across treatment, devices, and support services. This dedication drives the research and development of our pipeline products and our efforts to address areas of unmet medical need. 

Today, we are a global market leader in the field of fertility treatments. Our therapeutic portfolio, devices and advanced fertility technologies have helped many couples achieve their dream of having a baby. Everyone should have the opportunity to become a parent. To date, more than 5 million babies have been brought into the world with the help of our leading fertility products.

ElevateBio is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. ElevateBio is a company that powers the creation of cell and gene therapies with an integrated approach to technologies and manufacturing. ElevateBio employs 342 people (-8.2% YoY, -44 people) and has an annual revenue of $437M. Headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, United States, with an office in Cambridge. # Pioneering Medicines

Pioneering Medicines is a Biotechnology Research company. Flagship Pioneering is a biotechnology company that invents platforms and builds companies that change the world. Pioneering Medicines employs 105 people (+7.0% YoY, +8 people), founded in 2020. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States.

## About

Pioneering Medicines, Flagship Pioneering’s in house drug discovery
and development unit, is dedicated to conceiving and developing a broad
portfolio of life-changing treatments for patients built from Flagship’s
innovative platforms. Harnessing the drug development expertise of its
team together with the power of Flagship’s multiple scientific platforms,
Pioneering Medicines explores and identifies new product concepts and
then works jointly with Flagship’s companies to form integrated teams
that advance medicines through robust discovery and early clinical
development.

Pioneering Medicines also partners with external collaborators across
biopharma throughout the R&D process, applying its unique approach to
the R&D priorities of partners through highly co-creative relationships.
The team leads Flagship’s Innovation Supply Chain Partnerships with
Novo Nordisk and Pfizer to speed innovation in drug development and
bring novel therapies to patients, as well as a partnership with the Cystic
Fibrosis Foundation to develop therapeutics that address the unmet
needs of people living with cystic fibrosis.

properties.description:
Pioneering Medicines, Flagship Pioneering’s in house drug discovery
and development unit, is dedicated to conceiving and developing a broad
portfolio of life-changing treatments for patients built from Flagship’s
innovative platforms. Harnessing the drug development expertise of its
team together with the power of Flagship’s multiple scientific platforms,
Pioneering Medicines explores and identifies new product concepts and
then works jointly with Flagship’s companies to form integrated teams
that advance medicines through robust discovery and early clinical
development.

Pioneering Medicines also partners with external collaborators across
biopharma throughout the R&D process, applying its unique approach to
the R&D priorities of partners through highly co-creative relationships.
The team leads Flagship’s Innovation Supply Chain Partnerships with
Novo Nordisk and Pfizer to speed innovation in drug development and
bring novel therapies to patients, as well as a partnership with the Cystic
Fibrosis Foundation to develop therapeutics that address the unmet
needs of people living with cystic fibrosis.

# inSeption Group

inSeption Group is a Biotechnology Research company. inSeption Group is a company that specializes in complex programs and provides tailored support across every functional area. They aim to get life-changing therapies into the hands of patients and give families the power to change their story. InSeption Group employs 105 people and has an annual revenue of $14.1M, founded in 2011. Headquartered in Audubon, Pennsylvania, United States, with an office in Lansdale. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Canada, Australia, and Netherlands.

## About

In a changing clinical research landscape, inSeption is helping shape what comes next: a future grounded in integrity, transparency, and people who deliver with purpose.
 
As a full-service clinical outsourcing partner, we operate as a true extension of our clients’ teams, offering experienced leadership, flexible support, and thoughtful execution across every stage of development.
 
Together, we advance life-changing therapies to the patients who need them most—and help change the stories families get to tell.

# KCR Placement

KCR Placement is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. KCR Placement is a boutique provider of 'fit for purpose' resourcing solutions. They specialize in finding the right talents for pharma, biotech and medical device companies, as well as contract research organizations (CROs) across Europe. KCR Placement employs 104 people (-43.1% YoY) and has an annual revenue of $100M-$500M, founded in 2014. Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Its workforce is distributed across Poland, Estonia, United States, and Latvia.

KCR Placement is part of ICON plc, the world's leading provider of Functional Service Provision. # Virchow Biotech (Virchow Biotech Private Limited)

Virchow Biotech is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. Virchow Biotech employs 302 people (+1.4% YoY, +10 people), founded in 2001. Headquartered in India, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across India, Tanzania, Taiwan, and United States.

## About

Virchow Biotech (P) Ltd is an ISO 13485:2012 and WHO-GMP certified leading global player in Biopharma sector having around 20 years of operational experience and is situated at Hyderabad, India. We also have offices located in USA. Throughout the years, the company has been successful in Research and development, clinical trials, large-scale production and Commercialization of Plasma Products, Recombinants, Biologicals and Bio-Pharmaceuticals. With 1160 employees on the board, VBPL has an expansive infrastructure, which comprises of WHO cGMP and USFDA certified state-of-art clean-room manufacturing facilities and excellent fill-finish lines for PFS, vials, cartridges and lyophilized drug products.
VBPL focuses on the manufacturing of a wide range of biologicals and bio-generics by genetic engineering, classical fermentation or extraction technologies. Apart from this, we also offer Contract Research and Manufacturing services, co-development of products for various markets and customers around the world. 
Virchow Biotech is the part of Virchow Group incorporated in 1981. Other group companies are leading manufacturers of Sulphamethoxazole, Ranitidine, Cephalosporins and various other APIs. VBPL's achievements include being the first company in the world to commercialize biogenerics of PDGF, Teriparatide, Pegylated Interferon and Rasburicase. VBPL has a wide product portfolio across Woundcare, Gynaecology, Urology, Oncology, Vaccines and Probiotics etc.
Our mission is to provide high quality Biopharma products at an affordable price. Serving economically challenged patients across the globe through Biotechnology by extending our product base across various therapeutic segments.

VBPL focuses on the manufacturing of a wide range of biologicals and bio-generics by genetic engineering, classical fermentation or extraction technologies. Virchow Biotech is the part of Virchow Group incorporated in 1981. Other group companies are leading manufacturers of Sulphamethoxazole, Ranitidine, Cephalosporins and various other APIs. VBPL's achievements include being the first company in the world to commercialize biogenerics of PDGF, Teriparatide, Pegylated Interferon and Rasburicase. VBPL has a wide product portfolio across Woundcare, Gynaecology, Urology, Oncology, Vaccines and Probiotics etc.
Our mission is to provide high quality Biopharma products at an affordable price. Serving economically challenged patients across the globe through Biotechnology by extending our product base across various therapeutic segments.

# Biorce (Biorce ESP SL)

Biorce is a Biotechnology Research company. Biorce is a clinical trial platform that delivers AI powered solutions to help pharma, CROs, and biotech companies run faster and more efficient trials. Biorce employs 119 people (+508.7% YoY, +117 people), founded in 2024. Headquartered in Barcelona, Spain, with presence in United States, United Kingdom, and Portugal. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including Spain, United States, Portugal, United Kingdom, and Germany). Has $61.6M in total funding, with 4 prior funding rounds.

## About

Our mission is to dramatically reduce the time and cost of clinical trials. Aika, our AI platform, supports the various stages of the clinical trial lifecycle Phase 1-3, up until market approval. 

Clinical trials can take 11 years and cost ∼$6.2B to bring a drug to market. 
57% face costly protocol amendments that add months of delay.

We're changing that.

With Aika, users can generate compliant and comprehensive documents (feasibility studies, entire protocols, application forms, financial documents, consent forms etc.) within minutes. 

Aika features nearly 100% of clinical trials published in the past 25 years (1M+ trials from official registries), 260K+ clinical trial protocols, peer-reviewed articles, regulatory guidelines and many more. 

Every recommendation is backed by verifiable sources. Every decision stays with the clinical experts. Human oversight guaranteed. 

Faster trials don’t mean more risk. With Aika, they mean smarter science. 

The impact:
→ 50% faster protocol development
→ $200K-$400K saved per avoided amendment
→ Regulatory-ready outputs from day one

Built by clinical experts, for clinical experts.

Our mission is to dramatically reduce the time and cost of clinical trials. Aika, our AI platform, supports the various stages of the clinical trial lifecycle Phase 1-3, up until market approval. 

Clinical trials can take 11 years and cost ∼$6.2B to bring a drug to market. 
57% face costly protocol amendments that add months of delay.

We're changing that.

With Aika, users can generate compliant and comprehensive documents (feasibility studies, entire protocols, application forms, financial documents, consent forms etc.) within minutes. 

Aika features nearly 100% of clinical trials published in the past 25 years (1M+ trials from official registries), 260K+ clinical trial protocols, peer-reviewed articles, regulatory guidelines and many more. 

Every recommendation is backed by verifiable sources. Every decision stays with the clinical experts. Human oversight guaranteed. 

Faster trials don’t mean more risk. With Aika, they mean smarter science. 

The impact:
→ 50% faster protocol development
→ $200K-$400K saved per avoided amendment
→ Regulatory-ready outputs from day one

Built by clinical experts, for clinical experts.

# Merida Biosciences (Merida Biosciences, Inc.)

Merida Biosciences is a Biotechnology Research company. Merida Biosciences employs 57 people (+62.5% YoY, +25 people), founded in 2022. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States. Has $121M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

Merida Biosciences is a biotechnology company pioneering a new class of precision therapeutics designed to selectively and durably eliminate pathogenic antibodies that drive disease. The company is advancing a robust pipeline to precisely eliminate the root cause of multiple autoimmune and allergic conditions that are inadequately treated today. Its lead program is designed to specifically and rapidly clear the pathogenic autoantibodies that cause Graves' disease, an autoimmune disorder that affects the thyroid gland. Merida was publicly launched in April 2025 and is based in Cambridge, MA. For more information about Merida, visit www.meridabio.com.

# STAQ Pharma (STAQ Pharma, Inc.)

STAQ Pharma is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. STAQ Pharma is an FDA-registered 503B outsourcing partner that provides critical medications for pediatric and adult patients across the country. They are dedicated to combating drug shortages and supporting healthcare providers nationwide. Their commitment to safe, reliable medications is driven by four core values: safety, transparency, availability, and quality. STAQ Pharma employs 78 people (+24.5% YoY, +23 people). Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, United States, with an office in Columbus. Has $68.9M in total funding, with 6 prior funding rounds.

## About

STAQ Pharma | 503B Outsourcing Supplier Strengthening the Healthcare Supply Chain

Our mission is to ensure the reliable supply of critical medications, reducing drug shortages and improving patient care.

As a hospital-owned and directed outsourcing supplier, we are dedicated to strengthening the supply chain, understanding provider needs, and ensuring patients receive the safest medication.

STAQ Pharma’s core values—Safety, Transparency, Availability, and Quality—define our commitment to delivering reliable outsourced medications. These principles guide every aspect of our operations, ensuring patient safety, open communication, product accessibility, and uncompromising standards.

With facilities in Denver, CO, and Columbus, OH, STAQ Pharma is licensed nationwide and ships to over 800 healthcare locations monthly. Our proactive inventory management and rigorous quality control make us a trusted partner for healthcare systems across the country.

STAQ Pharma | 503B Outsourcing Supplier Strengthening the Healthcare Supply Chain

Our mission is to ensure the reliable supply of critical medications, reducing drug shortages and improving patient care.

As a hospital-owned and directed outsourcing supplier, we are dedicated to strengthening the supply chain, understanding provider needs, and ensuring patients receive the safest medication.

STAQ Pharma’s core values—Safety, Transparency, Availability, and Quality—define our commitment to delivering reliable outsourced medications. These principles guide every aspect of our operations, ensuring patient safety, open communication, product accessibility, and uncompromising standards.

With facilities in Denver, CO, and Columbus, OH, STAQ Pharma is licensed nationwide and ships to over 800 healthcare locations monthly. Our proactive inventory management and rigorous quality control make us a trusted partner for healthcare systems across the country.

🔗 Learn more: staqpharma.com

# PhaseV (PhaveV Trials Ltd.)

PhaseV is a Biotechnology Research company. PhaseV empowers biopharma sponsors and CROs with AI/ML-driven solutions for fast, efficient, and accurate clinical development decisions. PhaseV employs 55 people (+75.0% YoY, +27 people) and has an annual revenue of $32M. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States, with offices in Igal Alon 114 and Boston. Its workforce is distributed across Israel, United States, Netherlands, and United Kingdom. Has $65M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

PhaseV is a Boston-based technology company transforming clinical development with an enterprise-ready AI/ML platform that accelerates decisions, de-risks trials, and drives portfolio efficiency. Its Trial Optimizer designs smarter studies, reducing costs by up to 50%, lowering enrollment needs by 40%, shortening timelines by 40%, and boosting probability of success by 30%+. The ClinOps Optimizer enhances site selection by integrating patient-level insights with real-time dashboards to track performance. The Lifecycle Management module combines causal evidence, development complexity, and market value to inform portfolio decisions. Together, these solutions enable sponsors and CROs to optimize every stage of development.

# Leucine - AI for Pharma (Leucine Inc.)

Leucine - AI for Pharma is a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing company. Leucine is a company that provides AI-powered platforms for pharma manufacturing, enhancing quality, and optimizing productivity. Leucine - AI for Pharma employs 101 people (+18.1% YoY, +17 people) and has an annual revenue of $4M, founded in 2019. Headquartered in New York, United States, with offices in Bengaluru and Wilmington. Its workforce is distributed across India and United States. Has $8.1M in total funding, with 4 prior funding rounds.

## About

Leucine is an AI-powered platform that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant and audit-ready while ensuring the right first-time batch release.

Using Leucine, Manufacturing, QA, and QC teams can significantly increase productivity and reduce deviations from cGMP guidelines across thousands of complex regulated workflows from material receipt to batch release. Leucine supports manufacturers across all modalities such as small molecules, biologics, gene therapies, vaccines etc. 

We have built industry's first AI framework, Leucine10x, which is designed to serve as a co-pilot in pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. Built on proprietary LLM technology, Leucine 10X offers an army of AI co-pilots that perform highly specialized tasks such as digitizing paper-based SOPs, creating a digital twin of the shop floor, collaborating with Production Managers in creating dynamic production plans, thus ensuring on-time batch delivery. Most significant is its ability to speed up Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of deviations in the manufacturing process by quickly analyzing data, including text-based records, logs, and even staff interview transcripts, to identify potential issues or patterns that might not be readily apparent.

Leucine is currently deployed at over 50 companies in over 300 pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities across 10 countries, including the US, India, Brazil, Mexico, UAE, and others. Our customers trust us to help them deliver safe medicine to patients worldwide.

# Circle Pharma, Inc.

Circle Pharma, Inc. is a Biotechnology Research company. Circle Pharma is harnessing the power of macrocycles to transform cancer and other serious illnesses treatment. Circle Pharma, Inc. employs 53 people (-12.8% YoY, -10 people) and has an annual revenue of $3M, founded in 2012. Headquartered in South San Francisco, California, United States, with an office in San Francisco. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Switzerland. Has $207.5M in total funding, with 7 prior funding rounds.

## About

Circle Pharma initiated operations in June 2014 with seed funding from Pfizer, Inc. and Mission Bay Capital, LLP; we received additional seed funding from ShangPharma Investment Group Limited in November 2015. We recently raised Series B and Series C financing from The Column Group and NextTech Invest. 

We design and develop bioavailable macrocyclic peptide therapeutics against important clinical targets. We do this by applying a computational structure-based design approach that combines physics (conformational modeling), chemistry (innovative molecular components) and biology (protein target structure and function). We have selected intracellular protein-protein interactions that play key roles in cancer as the initial target group for our internal pipeline development.

Circle is taking a new approach to the development of macrocylic peptide therapeutics that is based on the pioneering work of its founders to understand and computationally predict drug-like properties of macrocycles. Circle is advancing this understanding to design novel, inherently permeable macrocyclic peptide drug candidates against Circle’s internal targets and those of our collaboration partners.

Our workflow includes the use of proprietary algorithms to design large, conformationally diverse, virtual libraries of cell permeable macrocyclic scaffolds that incorporate natural and non-natural backbone components. We deploy these virtual scaffold libraries in subsequent design steps that include the incorporation of functional side chains selected for both target binding and maintenance of permeability. Candidate compounds are synthesized and tested for both permeability and target affinity and the results are used to inform subsequent design cycles.

properties.description:
Circle Pharma initiated operations in June 2014 with seed funding from Pfizer, Inc. and Mission Bay Capital, LLP; we received additional seed funding from ShangPharma Investment Group Limited in November 2015. We recently raised Series B and Series C financing from The Column Group and NextTech Invest. 

We design and develop bioavailable macrocyclic peptide therapeutics against important clinical targets. We do this by applying a computational structure-based design approach that combines physics (conformational modeling), chemistry (innovative molecular components) and biology (protein target structure and function). We have selected intracellular protein-protein interactions that play key roles in cancer as the initial target group for our internal pipeline development.

Circle is taking a new approach to the development of macrocylic peptide therapeutics that is based on the pioneering work of its founders to understand and computationally predict drug-like properties of macrocycles. Circle is advancing this understanding to design novel, inherently permeable macrocyclic peptide drug candidates against Circle’s internal targets and those of our collaboration partners.

Our workflow includes the use of proprietary algorithms to design large, conformationally diverse, virtual libraries of cell permeable macrocyclic scaffolds that incorporate natural and non-natural backbone components. We deploy these virtual scaffold libraries in subsequent design steps that include the incorporation of functional side chains selected for both target binding and maintenance of permeability. Candidate compounds are synthesized and tested for both permeability and target affinity and the results are used to inform subsequent design cycles.

# Ampersand Biomedicines (Flagship Pioneering Inc.)

Ampersand Biomedicines is a Biotechnology Research company. Ampersand is a pioneering company that creates and programming therapeutics that are more efficacious, without compromising on safety or tolerability. They offer a proprietary address, navigate, determine (and) platform designed to create next-generation modular medicines that work precisely where needed in the body and nowhere else. Their and-body therapeutics combine elements that locate their intended target with. Ampersand Biomedicines employs 62 people (+30.9% YoY, +17 people) and has an annual revenue of $1M, founded in 2021. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Czechia, Portugal, and Germany. Has $115M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

Ampersand Biomedicines enables a new way of designing programmable medicines that work precisely where needed in the body and nowhere else. The company’s state-of-the-art computationally powered Address, Navigate, Design (AND)™ Platform continually learns the rules for identifying optimal localizer targets and refines its ability to design across the complex space of localizers and actuators. The result is increasingly sophisticated AND-Body™ therapeutics that are engineered across the physical constraints of molecules and the biological characteristics of the targets to effectively target the site of disease without affecting healthy tissue or cells. Ampersand Biomedicines was founded in 2020 at Flagship Labs, a unit of Flagship Pioneering.

properties.description: Ampersand Biomedicines enables a new way of designing programmable medicines that work precisely where needed in the body and nowhere else. The company’s state-of-the-art computationally powered Address, Navigate, Design (AND)™ Platform continually learns the rules for identifying optimal localizer targets and refines its ability to design across the complex space of localizers and actuators. The result is increasingly sophisticated AND-Body™ therapeutics that are engineered across the physical constraints of molecules and the biological characteristics of the targets to effectively target the site of disease without affecting healthy tissue or cells. Ampersand Biomedicines was founded in 2020 at Flagship Labs, a unit of Flagship Pioneering.

# Adcendo (Adcendo ApS)

Adcendo is a Biotechnology Research company. adcendo is a copenhagen-based biotech company dedicated to developing highly differentiated antibody-drug conjugates (adcs) for the treatment of underserved cancers. They have a spin-out from the university of Copenhagen and rigshospitalet and have recently published proof-of-conc. Adcendo employs 53 people (-5.9% YoY, -4 people) and has an annual revenue of $1.3M, founded in 2017. Headquartered in frederiksberg, capital region of denmark, Denmark, with an office in Copenhagen. Its workforce is distributed across 7 countries (including Denmark, United States, United Kingdom, France, and Italy). Has $324.6M in total funding, with 7 prior funding rounds.

## About

Adcendo is a global clinical-stage biotech company dedicated to developing transformative first- and potential best-in-class antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) therapies targeting cancers with high unmet medical need. Led by a team of experienced biopharma executives with a track record of advancing multiple ADCs to approval, Adcendo integrates novel targets, optimized linker-payload combinations, and a rationally designed development strategy to drive next-generation cancer therapies. 

Designed for Precision. 

Developed for Life.

Read more at www.adcendo.com
